subject: Culture
title: Unlucky Numbers and Objects
description: Learn Unlucky Numbers and Objects in one minute.

hook.text: Never give a Chinese person a clock as a gift. The phrase 'giving a clock' sounds identical to 'attending a funeral.'

buildup.text: Gift taboos are language-driven. Korean 'shoes' sound like 'running away.' Italian 'handkerchiefs' signal crying.

discovery.text: In Japan, giving gifts in sets of four is avoided because 'four' sounds like 'death' in both Japanese and Chinese.

twist.text: In Russia, even numbers of flowers are for funerals only. Arrive with twelve roses and you've cursed the host.

climax.text: These taboos seem irrational but they enforce cultural literacy. Knowing them signals you belong.

punchline.text: The wrong gift says you didn't care enough to learn the rules.

quiz.question: Why are clocks a taboo gift in China?
options: The phrase sounds like 'attending a funeral'
